meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装上后它会先复现 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的 bug,在临时工作区写最小修复并跑回归测试,再按归属交付:上游 openai/codex 发 fork PR,LazyCodex 自身缺陷提 verified-fix issue(不开 PR),最后附复现与验证命令并清理临时文件。
howto.when: 当你要求修 Bug、提交 Bug 修复、为 Bug 开 PR,或要求调试 LazyCodex、Codex 缺陷时触发。

say.text: 帮我修这个 LazyCodex 的 bug,复现步骤我贴给你
say.note: 会复现并提 verified-fix issue,而非 PR

say.text: 这是我的复现日志,帮我定位根因并给出最小修复补丁
say.note: 先写失败测试,再改最小代码

howto.what_en: It reproduces a LazyCodex or Codex bug, writes the smallest fix in a temporary workspace with a regression test, then delivers by owner: a fork PR for upstream openai/codex, or a verified-fix issue (never a PR) for LazyCodex-owned defects. It returns repro/verification commands and cleans up.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex bug; I'll paste the reproduction steps
say_en.note: Reproduces and files a verified-fix issue, not a PR

say_en.text: This Codex CLI bug reproduces reliably; open a PR to openai/codex
say_en.note: Fixes in a fresh clone and opens a fork PR

say_en.text: Here are my repro logs; find the root cause and give the smallest patch
say_en.note: Writes a failing test first, then the fix
